upsert.title: Hack the Audience 2026: Creator-to-CEO Hackathon
upsert.summary: Fully online 31-day rolling hackathon where teams of up to three pick one of five creator partners and build a product for that creator's audience. Capped at 100 teams; winning products may be promoted by creator partners under a 20% revenue share for two years.
upsert.eligibility: Free entry; teams of up to 3. No country restriction stated on the listing; confirm on the official page. Field capped at 100 teams, so register early.

prize.description: US$1,600 in cash plus sponsor credits from Render, Tin Computer and .xyz (split between cash and credits not stated).

notes: Runs Thu 5 Nov to Sat 5 Dec 2026 (UTC). No registration deadline stated on the listing page; official site: https://extriver.com/event1 (not independently opened).
